items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: my first teacher, a classical teacher, told me that the first lesson.

ctx.x: Jean Cros. Amazing guy. 82 years old. He told me, he said, “Before we proceed for the first lesson, you have to be very careful and to answer yes to this question, do you want to become a good bassist or do you want to play greatly bass? And I said, “Well if I may say I’d like to be both. He said, “That’s a good answer.” So he said, “If you want to play, if you and I tonight we want to go out and listen to great bass playing we simply go to the opera house.” That’s great bass. He said, “Now if tonight we decided…
